title: UI Label
description: An interface string. Buttons, tooltips, navigation labels, error messages, and other copy rendered in the UI. Each label carries its own metadata and localization flags.

sourceVersion.description: Version of the source file at the time this locale was reviewed. When source advances past this, the translation is flagged as stale by the validator.

translatorQuery.description: Populated when a translator identifies a structural issue in the source that blocks or degrades translation quality.

maxLengthValue.description:
Maximum character count for any translated string in this label. Applies to the static string including placeholder tokens (e.g. '{name}' counts as 6 characters), not to the runtime-substituted values.

Two forms are accepted:
- Integer: a single limit that applies to all locales.
- Object: per-locale limits. The 'default' key is required and applies to any locale not explicitly listed. BCP-47 locale keys (e.g. 'de', 'fi', 'nl') override the default for that locale.

Use the object form when you know that specific languages consistently expand relative to the source (German: ~1.35×, Finnish: ~1.80×, Dutch: ~1.25×). Set the per-locale limit by multiplying the source string length by the expansion factor and rounding up. Example: source is 20 chars → de: 28, fi: 36, default: 25.

oneOf.title: Single limit
oneOf.description: Applies to all locales. For short strings with tight UI constraints, consider using the object form to give Germanic languages more room.

default.description: Fallback limit for any locale not explicitly listed.

frozen.description: When true, the source content is locked. Must not be edited without bumping meta.version.

icu.description: Content strings use ICU MessageFormat syntax for plurals/gender. Example: '{count, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}'. Not validated by current validator.

labelType.description: The UI context. Affects length expectations and translation tone. Buttons: imperative, shortest. aria: often invisible but must be descriptive. error: constructive tone, avoid blame.

value.description: The string as it appears in the UI. Placeholder tokens (e.g. {name}, {count}) must be documented in the variables field.

variables.description: Documents each placeholder token used in value. Required when value contains any token. The validator cross-references this list against tokens actually found in the string.

name.description: Token as it appears in value, e.g. {name}

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this token holds at runtime

example.description: A realistic runtime value. Helps translators understand word order and gender agreement needs.

culturalNotes.description: Reviewer-facing. Tone intent, context for idioms, any adaptation guidance. Not shown in the UI.

content.culturalNotes: Exclamation mark is intentional — warm, not aggressive. If the target language convention avoids exclamation in UI, the reviewer may flag for removal.

localeReadiness.notes: Translated as 'Bentornata, {name}!' — gendered for female learner. For gender-neutral platforms this needs a translator query.
